name: Javier Mendoza
bio:
Javier's journey into motorsport began with a fascination for aviation, fueled by his grandfather's tales of being a mechanic on vintage aircraft. This interest naturally evolved into a passion for racing, specifically the intricate composite materials used in modern race cars. After completing his technical degree in Buenos Aires, he gained experience in the aerospace industry before making the jump to motorsport, joining a local touring car team. 

He approaches his role with meticulous precision, believing that even the smallest imperfection can have a significant impact on performance and safety. He is known for his innovative repair techniques and ability to troubleshoot complex composite issues. Javier is driven by a desire to constantly improve and push the boundaries of what's possible with composite technology. His ambition is to one day lead a team of composite technicians, implementing cutting-edge solutions that give his team a competitive edge.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: Javier is of average height with a sturdy build and a focused gaze.

quirks: Always sharpens his pencils to a needlepoint before starting any task.
Has a collection of miniature racing helmets on his desk.
Speaks to the carbon fiber panels as if they are his children.
